request.style: English, classic storytelling country, deep warm male baritone vocal, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, fiddle, piano, slow shuffle drums, tender and redemptive, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I was the younger son and I wanted it all now
Said, Father, give me my share, I'm through behind this plow
He divided up his property, I gathered everything
And I left for a distant country where the money made me king

[Verse]
But the money ran like water and the famine came to town
I was feeding pigs for strangers with my head hung down
I longed to eat the pods they ate, but no one gave me a crumb
Then I came to myself and I thought of where I'd come from

[Pre-Chorus]
I will get up and go to my father
I am no longer worthy to be called your son
Treat me as one of your hired hands

[Chorus]
While I was still a long way off
My father saw me on the road
He ran to me and held me tight
He kissed me and he brought me home
This son of mine was dead and is alive again
He was lost and is found

[Verse]
My brother heard the music as he came in from the field
He stood outside in anger and his heart would not yield
So our father came outside to him and pleaded with him there
My child, you're always with me, all I have is yours to share

[Bridge]
We had to celebrate and rejoice
Because this brother of yours was dead and is alive
He was lost and is found

[Chorus]
While I was still a long way off
My father saw me on the road
He ran to me and held me tight
He kissed me and he brought me home
This son of mine was dead and is alive again
He was lost and is found
